import pandas as pd, numpy as np

k="school sex age address famsize Pstatus Medu Fedu Mjob Fjob reason nursery internet guardian traveltime studytime schoolsup famsup activities higher romantic famrel freetime goout health".split()
m['sub']='mat';p['sub']='por'
a=pd.concat([m,p],ignore_index=True)
a['sid']=a.groupby(k,sort=False).ngroup()   # same student across files

print('rows',len(a),'unique students',a.sid.nunique(),'in both',n_both)
a['zero']=(a.G3==0)
a['G3v']=a.G3.where(~a.zero)
def stud(col):
    g=a.groupby('sid')
    s=g.agg(Dalc=('Dalc','mean'),Walc=('Walc','mean'),G3=(col,'mean'),sex=('sex','first'),age=('age','first'),
            studytime=('studytime','mean'),failures=('failures','max'),higher=('higher','first'),school=('school','first'),
            Medu=('Medu','first'),Fedu=('Fedu','first'),goout=('goout','first'),absences=('absences','mean'),nsub=('sub','nunique'),zero=('zero','max'))
    s['alc']=(5*s.Dalc+2*s.Walc)/7
    return s

S=S.dropna(subset=['G3']); print('students analysed',len(S),'excluded (only zeros)',a.sid.nunique()-len(S))

def boot(f,n=2000,*arrs):
    idx=len(arrs[0]);r=[]
    for _ in range(n):
        i=rng.integers(0,idx,idx);r.append(f(*[x[i] for x in arrs]))
    return np.percentile(r,[2.5,97.5])
def ols(X,y,names):
    X=np.column_stack([np.ones(len(y)),X]);b=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y,rcond=None)[0];e=y-X@b
    H=np.linalg.inv(X.T@X);h=np.einsum('ij,jk,ik->i',X,H,X);V=H@(X.T*(e/(1-h))**2)@X@H
    se=np.sqrt(np.diag(V));df=len(y)-X.shape[1];t=b/se;pv=2*stats.t.sf(abs(t),df)
    return pd.DataFrame({'b':b,'se':se,'p':pv},index=['const']+names)

        x,y=D[v].values,D.G3.values
        rho,pr=stats.spearmanr(x,y); r,pp=stats.pearsonr(x,y)
        ci=boot(lambda u,w:stats.spearmanr(u,w)[0],1000,x,y)

          thr=f'>={thr}',n_hi=len(hi),mean_hi=hi.mean(),mean_lo=lo.mean(),diff=hi.mean()-lo.mean(),cohen_d=d,d_lo=dci[0],d_hi=dci[1],p_welch=tw.pvalue,p_mw=mw.pvalue,

Z=Sall.copy()
for v in['Dalc','Walc']:
    hi=Z[Z[v]>=3].zero.mean();lo=Z[Z[v]<3].zero.mean();print(v,'zero rate hi/lo',hi,lo,stats.fisher_exact([[ (Z[Z[v]>=3].zero).sum(),(Z[v]>=3).sum()-(Z[Z[v]>=3].zero).sum()],[(Z[Z[v]<3].zero).sum(),(Z[v]<3).sum()-(Z[Z[v]<3].zero).sum()]]))
